title: Reconditioned for Love (ORIGINAL)
description: The other day you'd nervously confessed your love for one of your closest friends, only to be instantly rejected. To your immense relief, however, your crush still wishes to remain friends and has invited you back over to her place for the first time in what feels like weeks. Yet to your surprise when you arrive, she hurriedly sits you down to explain her real feelings about you ... suddenly confessing that she's had also had a crush on you for the longest time as well. How in truth, she was nervous about ruining the friendship, and had picked up on the lack of confidence you'd conveyed. How much more she loved the confident and complete version of yourself: the adorable loser she liked to tease and banter with. And was hurt that you seemed to feel so underserving of her love, even so far as expecting the rejection. But when your girlfriend is a hypnotist, and you're a willing hypnotic subject, helping you see yourself the way she sees you is easier then you think. And this bold new you isn't going to hold back their passion any longer ...
author: Mistress Shibby
